--- title: "Panel 2 · Bivariate & Spatial Explorer" subtitle: "Pairwise scatterplots · Bivariate Moran's I · LISA maps · MAUP sensitivity" date: last-modified --- ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## About this panel This panel explores **relationships between variables** rather than the distribution of any single variable. Each section asks a different question: - **§2.1 Scatterplots:** Are conflict history and justice infrastructure correlated? Do municipalities with more peacebuilding investment have lower violence? Points are municipality means across all available years. Axes are log-scaled to handle extreme skew. - **§2.2 Bivariate Moran's I:** Does the geographic neighbor of a high-conflict municipality also have low justice infrastructure? Bivariate spatial autocorrelation tests this. - **§2.3 LISA Maps:** Which specific municipalities drive the spatial clustering? High-High = conflict cluster; Low-Low = peaceful cluster; High-Low / Low-High = spatial outliers (interesting cases). - **§2.4 MAUP Sensitivity:** Does the spatial pattern depend on how we allocate UCDP events to municipal boundaries? This section tests robustness to different aggregation rules. All spatial weights use **Queen contiguity** restricted to the 170 PDET municipalities. ::: --- ## 2.1 Pairwise Scatterplots Scatterplots for key variable pairs across **PDET municipalities (n = 170)**. Each point is one municipality. Axes are log(1 + x) transformed. Hover for municipality names. ::: panel-tabset ```{.r .cell-code} if (nrow(panel) > 0) { for (pair in CORE_VARS) { cat(glue::glue("\n\n### {pair$title}\n\n")) xd <- panel_cross(pair$x_var) yd <- panel_cross(pair$y_var) if (is.null(xd) || is.null(yd)) { cat("> One or both variables not in panel.\n\n") next } df_join <- xd |> dplyr::rename(x_val = v) |> dplyr::inner_join(yd |> dplyr::rename(y_val = v), by = "dane_code") |> dplyr::left_join( pdet_munis |> sf::st_drop_geometry() |> dplyr::select(dane_code, muni_name), by = "dane_code") |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(x_val) & !is.na(y_val)) if (nrow(df_join) < 5) { cat("> Fewer than 5 matched rows.\n\n") next } rho <- cor(log1p(df_join$x_val), log1p(df_join$y_val), method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs") p <- plotly::plot_ly( df_join, x = ~log1p(x_val), y = ~log1p(y_val), type = "scatter", mode = "markers", text = ~paste0("", muni_name, "", "
", pair$x_label, ": ", round(x_val, 1), "
", pair$y_label, ": ", round(y_val, 1)), hoverinfo = "text", marker = list(size = 7, opacity = 0.65, color = "#2166ac") ) |> plotly::layout( title = list(text = pair$title, font = list(size = 14)), xaxis = list(title = paste0("log(1 + ", pair$x_label, ")")), yaxis = list(title = paste0("log(1 + ", pair$y_label, ")")), annotations = list(list( x = 0.05, y = 0.95, xref = "paper", yref = "paper", text = paste0("Spearman rho = ", round(rho, 3)), showarrow = FALSE, font = list(size = 12) )) ) print(htmltools::tagList(p)) cat("\n\n") } } else { cat("> Panel not loaded. Run the pipeline first.\n") } ``` ### UCDP vs. CNMH: conflict count cross-validation
### Conflict history vs. formal justice infrastructure
### Conflict history vs. community mediation
### Homicide rate vs. institutional justice demand
### Peacebuilding investment vs. conflict history
::: ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## 2.2 Bivariate Moran's I ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} compute_bivariate_moran <- function(x, y, lw) { x[is.na(x)] <- 0 y[is.na(y)] <- 0 if (stats::var(x) == 0 || stats::var(y) == 0) return(c(I = NA, p = NA)) x_std <- as.numeric(scale(x)) y_std <- as.numeric(scale(y)) wy <- spdep::lag.listw(lw, y_std, zero.policy = TRUE) I <- mean(x_std * wy) perm_I <- replicate(999, { yp <- y_std[sample(length(y_std))] wyp <- spdep::lag.listw(lw, yp, zero.policy = TRUE) mean(x_std * wyp) }) p <- mean(abs(perm_I) >= abs(I)) c(I = I, p = p) } lw_q <- get_lw() if (!is.null(lw_q) && !is.null(pdet_munis) && nrow(panel) > 0) { # Build cross-section aligned with geometry geo_base <- pdet_munis |> sf::st_drop_geometry() |> dplyr::select(dane_code) biv_rows <- purrr::map(CORE_VARS, function(pair) { xd <- panel_cross(pair$x_var) yd <- panel_cross(pair$y_var) if (is.null(xd) || is.null(yd)) return(NULL) xv <- dplyr::left_join(geo_base, xd, by = "dane_code") |> dplyr::pull(v) yv <- dplyr::left_join(geo_base, yd, by = "dane_code") |> dplyr::pull(v) mi <- compute_bivariate_moran(xv, yv, lw_q) tibble::tibble(X = pair$x_label, Y = pair$y_label, `Bivariate Moran's I` = round(mi["I"], 4), `p-value (perm)` = round(mi["p"], 4)) }) biv_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(purrr::compact(biv_rows)) if (nrow(biv_results) > 0) { DT::datatable(biv_results, rownames = FALSE, caption = "Bivariate Moran's I (999 permutations, queen weights, PDET municipalities)", options = list(dom = "t", pageLength = 20)) } else { cat("> No variable pairs with sufficient data.\n") } } else { cat("> Panel or geometry not loaded.\n") } ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## 2.3 LISA Maps ::: panel-tabset ```{.r .cell-code} LISA_COLOURS <- c("HH" = "#b2182b", "LL" = "#2166ac", "HL" = "#f4a582", "LH" = "#92c5de", "Not significant" = "#dddddd") lisa_vars_p2 <- list( list(var = "V_conflict_events_all__ucdp", label = "UCDP Events"), list(var = "V_selective_killing_cases__cnmh", label = "CNMH Selective Killings"), list(var = "V_homicides_mean__jep", label = "Homicide Rate (VERDATA)"), list(var = "J_n_justice_rooms__slj", label = "Justice Rooms (SLJ)") ) lw_q <- get_lw() if (!is.null(lw_q) && !is.null(pdet_munis) && nrow(panel) > 0) { geo_base <- pdet_munis |> sf::st_drop_geometry() |> dplyr::select(dane_code) for (lv in lisa_vars_p2) { cat(glue::glue("\n\n### {lv$label}\n\n")) vd <- panel_cross(lv$var) if (is.null(vd)) { cat("> Variable not in panel.\n\n") next } vals <- dplyr::left_join(geo_base, vd, by = "dane_code") |> dplyr::pull(v) vals[is.na(vals)] <- 0 if (stats::var(vals) == 0) { cat("> Zero variance — skipping LISA.\n\n") next } locm <- tryCatch( suppressWarnings(spdep::localmoran(vals, lw_q, zero.policy = TRUE)), error = function(e) NULL) if (is.null(locm)) { cat("> LISA computation failed.\n\n") next } vals_std <- as.numeric(scale(vals)) lag_vals <- spdep::lag.listw(lw_q, vals_std, zero.policy = TRUE) quad <- dplyr::case_when( vals_std > 0 & lag_vals > 0 & locm[, 5] < 0.05 ~ "HH", vals_std < 0 & lag_vals < 0 & locm[, 5] < 0.05 ~ "LL", vals_std > 0 & lag_vals < 0 & locm[, 5] < 0.05 ~ "HL", vals_std < 0 & lag_vals > 0 & locm[, 5] < 0.05 ~ "LH", TRUE ~ "Not significant" ) lisa_sf <- pdet_munis |> dplyr::mutate(lisa_quad = quad, lisa_I = locm[, 1], lisa_p = locm[, 5]) lisa_sf$lisa_quad <- factor(lisa_sf$lisa_quad, levels = c("HH","LL","HL","LH","Not significant")) g <- ggplot2::ggplot(lisa_sf) + ggplot2::geom_sf(ggplot2::aes(fill = lisa_quad), color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) + ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = LISA_COLOURS, drop = FALSE, name = "LISA (p<0.05)") + ggplot2::labs(title = lv$label) + ggplot2::theme_void(base_size = 10) + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "right") print(g) cat("\n\n") } } else { cat("> Panel or geometry not loaded.\n") } ``` ### UCDP Events ![](panel2_bivariate_files/figure-html/lisa-maps-p2-1.png){width=1050} ### CNMH Selective Killings ![](panel2_bivariate_files/figure-html/lisa-maps-p2-2.png){width=1050} ### Homicide Rate (VERDATA) ![](panel2_bivariate_files/figure-html/lisa-maps-p2-3.png){width=1050} ### Justice Rooms (SLJ) ![](panel2_bivariate_files/figure-html/lisa-maps-p2-4.png){width=1050} ::: ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## 2.4 MAUP Sensitivity (UCDP) ::: panel-tabset ### Weight matrix sensitivity ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} if (!is.null(maup_weights)) { DT::datatable(dplyr::arrange(maup_weights, dplyr::desc(morans_I)), rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t"), caption = "Moran's I under queen, rook, knn4 weights") } else { cat("> ⚠️ `ucdp_maup_weights_sensitivity.csv` not found.\n") } ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### Year-by-year Moran's I ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} if (!is.null(maup_byyear)) { mb <- maup_byyear |> dplyr::mutate( year = as.integer(stringr::str_extract(specification, "^[0-9]{4}")), type = stringr::str_extract(specification, "all$|interior$") ) |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(year)) plotly::plot_ly(mb, x = ~year, y = ~morans_I, color = ~type, type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers", colors = c("all" = "#b2182b", "interior" = "#2166ac")) |> plotly::layout(title = "Year-by-year Moran's I (UCDP, queen weights)", xaxis = list(title = "Year"), yaxis = list(title = "Moran's I")) } else { cat("> ⚠️ `ucdp_maup_morans_by_year.csv` not found.\n") } ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### Boundary-distance threshold ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} if (!is.null(maup_thresh)) { DT::datatable( dplyr::arrange(maup_thresh, as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(specification, "^[0-9]+"))), rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t"), caption = "Moran's I sensitivity to boundary exclusion distance (km)") } else { cat("> ⚠️ `ucdp_maup_threshold_sensitivity.csv` not found.\n") } ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### UCDP × CNMH cross-validation ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} if (!is.null(crossval)) { cv <- tryCatch( crossval |> dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c("dane_code", "muni_name", "dept_name", "ucdp_total", "cnmh_total", "log_ratio", "high_discrepancy", "cnmh_source"))) |> dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(log_ratio))) |> head(50), error = function(e) NULL) if (!is.null(cv)) { DT::datatable(cv, rownames = FALSE, caption = "Top 50 by |log-ratio| (UCDP vs CNMH)", options = list(pageLength = 15, dom = "ftp")) } else cat("> ⚠️ Could not parse crossval file.\n") } else { cat("> ⚠️ `ucdp_cnmh_crossvalidation.rds` not found.\n") } ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### Cross-validation by department ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} if (!is.null(dept_cor)) { DT::datatable(dplyr::arrange(dept_cor, rho_spearman), rownames = FALSE, caption = "Dept-level Spearman rho: UCDP vs CNMH (n >= 3)", options = list(pageLength = 20, dom = "ftp")) |> DT::formatStyle("rho_spearman", background = DT::styleColorBar(c(-1, 1), "#cce5ff")) } else { cat("> ⚠️ `ucdp_cnmh_crossval_by_dept.csv` not found.\n") } ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: :::
